'''Mark Chambers''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[December 2001 Colorado Springs tournament]] on 9 December 2001 with [[Endor Operations / Imperial Outpost|Endor Ops]], according to Cody Jewell's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3201">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-12-20-tournament-report-sunday-december-92k1d3201/ tournament-report-sunday-december-92k1], DeckTech (Cody "MegaScrub" Jewell, 20 December 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-12-20-tournament-report-sunday-december-92k1d3201/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
